apps.name: iNKillerPlus
apps.subtitle: Instagram with downloads, ghost mode and no ads
apps.localizedDescription: iNKillerPlus is a modified Instagram by iKarwan. Download posts, reels, stories and DM media, save profile pictures, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen for stories and DMs, ghost typing, hide tabs, copy comments and bios, confirmation prompts before liking or calling, and a profile analyzer. iPadOS supported.
apps.versionDescription:
Instagram 446.0.0 | Instagram_446.0_iNKillerPlus_5.2

• Fix profile bio long press to copy detect email and links
• Fix read DM icon
• Fix user exception for direct message
• Add roothide & relaxin JB support
• Add full compatibility with IG v440+
• Add tab configuration for hide & launch
• Fix swipe between tabs
• Fix story mention button crashes on v440+
• Fix story download button
• Fix eye long-press user exception on v440+
• Fix follow confirmation toggle
• Fix long-press profile picture expand & download
• Fix grid button in main navbar
• Fix 2x2 grid handling in 3x3 position style
• Fix photo picker with music on multiple posts for iOS 27 Liquid Glass
• Other fixes & improvements
• Updated base IPA to Instagram v446.0
